calculation.description: Where today's close sits inside the trailing 20-day high-low range, normalized to [0,1]. Values near 1 mean the asset closes near its recent range high (short-term uptrend / strength); values near 0 mean it closes near the range low. Positive cross-sectional predictive power at 10-20d horizon indicates trend continuation of the range position, while 1-2d IC is negative (short-term reversal around the range edges).

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2020-01-01..2026-07-15 on the 15-asset cross-asset universe (equity indices, commodities, crypto, yield series) across multiple regimes: COVID crash 2020, recovery bull 2020-21, 2022 tightening bear, 2023-24 AI-led equity rally, 2024-26 crypto/commodity cycles. Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC, min 8 valid instruments per date.
